description: This is a PHP source file defining the Handling class within the OpenCart e-commerce system. The class extends the base Model class and implements functionality related to calculating totals for handling fees in the cart, including tax calculations.

classes.name: Handling
classes.description: A model class responsible for calculating and adding handling fees and related taxes to the total order calculation.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the handling fee to the totals array if the cart subtotal exceeds the configured total handling threshold, including applicable tax rates.
